description.short_caption: Small erythematous lesion with central punctum on the right arm.
description.detailed_description: This clinical photograph shows the right arm of a patient, positioned on a hospital bed. A small, erythematous lesion with a central punctum is visible on the lateral aspect of the arm. The surrounding skin appears unremarkable, with no significant swelling or additional lesions. The lesion may suggest a localized infection, insect bite, or abscess formation.
